results.title: Delhi’s old RTR flyover to reopen for bikes, cars after load testing; buses, trucks barred for at least another week
results.content: Airport buses, DTC and company employee buses to be diverted to service road as repaired concrete cures; height barriers, signboards planned to keep heavy vehicles off the ramp

results.title: Minor fire breaks out at Delhi’s North Block, six fire tenders rushed to spot
results.content: Delhi Fire Services received a distress call at 11.10 a.m., following which six fire tenders rushed to the spot. The fire was doused by 11.25 a.m.

results.title: Why did Tinder’s scam detection fail, and what should Indian users do?
results.content: U.S. lawmakers shared troubling statistics about how dating app users on Tinder and Hinge were matching with scammers, due to outdated AI protections
